purpose: Closes P3 §pathc_caveats item (b) — explicit DESI OOD MSE threshold-in-OOD-units (R3/R4 GPT-B1 multi-round deferral).
interpolation_method: linear in (percentile, log10(MSE)) between p99 and p99.9
interpretation: To preserve the 0.87% headline anomaly rate on a representative random SPARCL OOD sample, the per-sample cut should be the OOD 99.13th percentile, which is MSE ≈ 60.22 in standardized units (equivalently S ≈ 2098 relative to the training-pool reference, i.e. ~420× the curated-catalog S>5 cut). Conversely, applying the curated S>5 (MSE>0.143) cut as-is to the OOD sample flags 52.8% of OOD spectra (61× the headline rate), confirming the curation-not-threshold reconciliation.
